name: model_routing
title: Where to send each request (routing)
what_it_tests: Choose between a canned answer, a cheap LLM, an advanced LLM or a human agent, and rate the difficulty. This is the 'Jev in front, expensive LLM only when needed' use case.

canned_answer.what: Frequently asked question with a fixed answer, such as hours, address or phone number

fast_model.what: Simple text task, such as translating, correcting or summarizing something short

advanced_model.what: Complex task: long reasoning, programming, analysis of a large document

human.what: Sensitive situation or a customer asking to talk to a person

difficulty.instructions: How much expertise and work it takes to handle the request well. Judge the task itself, not how long or short the message is
criteria: Looking up a fixed fact the business already has written down, such as hours, address or phone number
A short text task anyone fluent could do, such as translating, correcting, rephrasing or summarizing a few lines
Needs expert knowledge or several steps of reasoning, even when the message is short, such as debugging code, tuning a query or doing financial math
Large or multi-part work, such as analyzing a long document, writing a full plan or designing a system
